about_the_game:
A thrilling fusion of spatial organization and auto-battler combat! With diverse equipment combos and clever strategy designs, we aim to deliver heart-pounding battles that leave players pumped and sweating. Pick your toys and dive into the action!

               

Summon units for intense "collision" battles where victory isn’t just about numbers! Charge boldly to knock opponents off the table, flipping the battlefield in unpredictable ways and making every tabletop clash wildly exciting.

             

Winning the battle depends not only on the choice of toys, but also on the art of toy placement within the desk space! Plan your toy placement wisely and add more toys to the limited number of squares. By combining different toys, you can also synthesise rare and powerful toys to sweep the desk!

             

Harness toy synergies and the support effects of magical toys. Experiment with powerful build archetypes to create unique, electrifying strategies, sparking the battlefield with combos like the Paper Plane Swarm, Penholder Missile Barrage, and countless other playstyles waiting for your creativity.

       

From the Plush Chef commanding kitchen toys, to the Punk Guitarist Puppet rocking wild chords, to the Hamster Magician leading the Hamster Legion—the battlefield is brimming with quirky characters! A massive toy roster is ready for you to assemble your dream team.

  • 60+ Summonable Toy Units to rule the tabletop battlefield

  • 15+ Trap Toys to flip the battle in your favor

  • 150+ Magical Toys to unlock stronger battlefield effects
